rejections: section lateral excursion exceeds declared fraction of declared contact envelope minimum width

base_contact_policy.note: Lateral/overlap/perimeter are declared trial policies, not physical laws. Explicit lateral/overlap values permit a bounded contact experiment, not a material-feasibility claim. The initial COM search radius does not change the 30 mm individual or 50 mm cumulative correction budget. The 5 mm minimum teddy/left-robot clearance is an engineering preflight allowance, not a physical law. Bottom clearance and lateral trial fraction are configurable; no compression is prescribed.

mouth.caliper_width_geometry: XY convex contact envelope, not the actual opening
mouth.scope: Finite contact-trial search envelope. A connected separated spatial rim and its convex shadow do not establish a free aperture, empty interior, or safe passage; native contact and unchanged final containment remain required.

topology.body_face_selection: explicit physical body-face labels mapped to imported rest mesh

section_guard_rejections: section lateral excursion exceeds declared fraction of declared contact envelope minimum width
rim_height_section_envelopes.comparison_geometry: XY convex contact envelope of actual spatial rim; not actual opening
rim_height_section_envelopes.wall_contact_risk: Initial entry and lateral centering may contact upper side panels, not only the free rim. Native CCD/contact must prevent actual penetration; no geometry is imposed.
